title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen: Google's Free AI Just Got Faster ⚡
description:
Gemini 4 Hydrogen is Google's newest fast AI model, rolling out now in the Gemini app and Google Search. Google says it finishes tasks 2.5 times faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash, and it scored 51 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, one point above the paid Gemini 4 Argon (50). Free Gemini users get it automatically when a prompt needs it.

Faster or smarter: which matters more to you? Tell us in the comments!

🔔 Follow AI Daily Drop for the newest AI tools and tech news every day.

Source: Google, "Introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen" (November 12, 2026); FoneArena (November 13, 2026)
